facts.business: Keystone Realtors Limited is a real estate development company focused on residential projects, primarily redevelopment and cluster redevelopment in Mumbai.

segments.name: Revenue from Operations - At a point in time

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company added 5 projects during the year, all redevelopment, with a combined estimated gross development value (GDV) of ₹10,420 crore, equivalent to 1.74 times the guidance for the year and 118% higher than FY25.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text

key_risks: Revenue recognition involves significant management judgement in identifying performance obligations and determining when control is transferred
Estimation of costs to complete for projects where revenue is recognised over time using percentage of completion method
Interest rate risk on variable rate borrowings (₹14,041 crore as at March 31, 2026)
Changes in economic conditions, real estate market dynamics, regulatory developments, pace of project approvals and execution
facts.related_party_note: The Company has joint controlled entities: Rustomjee Evershine Joint Venture (50%), Lok Fortune Joint Venture (60%), and Fortune Partners. Revenue from operations from joint controlled entities was INR 317 lakh in FY26.
